name: wetestcase-ms
description: TestCase MS monorepo — web app + shared DTOs

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @wetestcase/dto && npm run typecheck -w @wetestcase/web && npm run typecheck -w @wetestcase/runner
scripts.tunnel:own: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production --profile quick up -d --no-deps quicktunnel
scripts.tunnel:own:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production --profile quick stop quicktunnel && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production --profile quick rm -f quicktunnel
